headline: One photo, 317 different works
reasons: The same photo file (fingerprint ac353f97338e) is attached to 317 different works in 1 village. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 317 separate works.
The works are recorded as: Contour Trench (317).
Each of the 317 works started and ended on a single day. The works are spread over 3 dates: 2026-05-25, 2026-05-26, 2026-05-28.
